question: Kevin starts from point A and drives 7 km towards the North. He then takes two simultaneous right turns and drives 2 km and 1 km, respectively. He then takes a left turn and drives 3 km. He then takes two simultaneous right turns and drives 3 km each. He takes a final left turn and drives 3 km to reach point B. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90 degrees turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given:

Kevin starts from point A and drives 7 km towards the North. He then takes two simultaneous right turns and drives 2 km and 1 km, respectively.

He then takes a left turn and drives 3 km. He then takes two simultaneous right turns and drives 3 km each.

He takes a final left turn and drives 3 km to reach point B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f98b51696ac1764213746c1d28f300e2e24e204a417d14d77391eddf61d15007.png] 

Thus, Kevin has to drive **2 km West to reach Point A again.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
